description:
Perform a complete end-to-end workflow: 
1. Go to BACK OFFICE (PIN: 1111) and create a new Modifier Group named 'Burger Toppings' containing three modifiers: 'Bacon' ($1.50), 'Avocado' ($2.00), and 'Extra Cheese' ($0.75).
2. Create a new Menu Item named 'Build-Your-Own Burger' ($9.99), assign it to any existing Group (e.g., 'Entree' or 'Sandwich'), and link the 'Burger Toppings' modifier group to it.
3. Return to the main screen, go to DINE IN, select a table, and place an order for the 'Build-Your-Own Burger'.
4. Select 'Bacon' and 'Avocado' as modifiers.
5. Settle (Pay) the order using CASH.

The final ticket subtotal should be approx $13.49.
